provenance.derivedFrom: per-domain exam-objective notes (a private source set), whose headings track the published April-2024 outline one-to-one
provenance.areaLabels: Area ids and titles are taxonomy, recorded as published — the same treatment the OWASP category names get. No explanatory prose is carried, and nothing in this file is authoring input; it is the scope ruler.
provenance.weights: Domain weights are the published April-2024 blueprint percentages. They are NOT derived from any vendored artifact — confirm against the ISC2 outline PDF before using them to weight a sampler. Nothing in the coverage gate reads them.
